text:
anna_support: Hey billing team — Voss LLC (DE) has an invoice stuck because their EU VAT ID returned 'unverified' during our automated check and our system flagged reverse-charge not allowed. Customer uploaded a resale cert PDF and says VIES intermittently returns 404 for them.
michael_billing: Thanks Anna. I can see invoice #INV-2026-372 on hold. Our validate_vat job hit a 502 -> 404 retry loop at 10:12 UTC. Customer screenshot attached in ticket.
ivan_compliance: @michael_billing can you paste the raw response body from the VIES call? sometimes it's a country-specific error.
michael_billing: Pasting the snippet: `{"status":404,"error":"No data for VAT ID","request_id":"req_0a12"}`. Also saw an occasional `504 gateway timeout`.
jen_prodops: We had a maintenance window for the EU proxy earlier today — could explain intermittent 504s. But a 404 is upstream. @ivan_compliance do we have fallback logic to accept manual resale certs?
ivan_compliance: We do, but it's manual and requires 1) scanned resale certificate with company name and VAT ID, 2) business registration or purchase order proving B2B, and 3) approval from Compliance. Uploads go to S3 folder `manual-vat-queue/`.
anna_support: Customer already uploaded the PDF to the support ticket (file: voss_resale_cert.pdf). They also provided their PO number. They need the invoice released to pay by EOM.
michael_billing: I'll move the invoice to "pending-manual-review" and attach the file. Action items for Compliance below. Also logging the API error: `billing.validate_vat()` -> `VATService.callVIES(vat_id)` returned 404 at 1728853712.
ivan_compliance: I'll take it. Quick checklist I'm following: 1) confirm VAT ID matches legal entity name on resale cert; 2) confirm document authenticity (scanned header, official stamp OR notarization); 3) compare company registration number where available. If all good, we stamp as exempt and allow reverse-charge.
taxbot: [automated] Reminder: manual VAT validations must be completed within 3 business days per policy. See policy link: https://redwood.internal/policies/vat-manual-validation
jen_prodops: For future resilience, can Engineering add a retry-with-backoff + cached last-known-good result for VIES responses? We should also surface a clearer error to customers: "VIES unreachable / manual review required" instead of just "unverified".
michael_billing: Agree. Filing ENG ticket now: `ENG-6421` — Add: exponential backoff (3 retries), cache last successful response per VAT ID (ttl 24h), surface user-facing message to support console.
anna_support: For this thread, next steps: @ivan_compliance review the uploaded cert, @michael_billing mark invoice pending-manual, @jen_prodops follow up on ENG-6421 for next sprint. I'll message the customer an ETA this afternoon.
ivan_compliance: Reviewed the PDF — name and VAT ID match, stamp present but no notarization. I'll escalate to senior compliance for final sign-off; ETA 8 business hours.
michael_billing: Done — invoice moved to `pending-manual-review`. Added internal note: `VIES intermittent 404/504; manual cert on file.`
anna_support: Customer reply: "Thanks, please release if you can — we need to submit payment before month-end." I'll keep them updated.
ivan_compliance: Approved. Marking invoice exempt under reverse-charge. Please update accounting code and release.
michael_billing: Released invoice INV-2026-372 and sent updated PDF to customer. Closing hold. Marking root cause: VIES intermittent failures for DE vat IDs, mitigation: manual fallback and ENG ticket.
jen_prodops: Thanks everyone. I'll add monitoring for VIES error rates and alert on >1% 5m error rate. ENG ticket ENG-6421 includes monitoring + caching + user message changes.
anna_support: Closing loop with customer now. :thumbsup:

taxbot: [automated] Action completed: `manual_vat_review` by ivan_compliance recorded at 1728854910.
